l.comment: 36px (mobile variant, same height as M but font bumped to 16px)

gap.comment: 4px icon-label gap — corrects noir.theme.ts's 6px, verified against Figma node 22465:93605

legacyMapping.eventsUi: noir.theme.ts button.root.gap was hand-set to 6px; Figma spec is 4px

disabledTextColor.comment: button-specific disabled text — distinct from semantic text.disabled (#869097)

xl.comment: 42px — Figma node 13197:91897; every 'Size=XL (42) (Mob)' symbol measures height=42. Was 2.5rem/40px, a value no Figma variant specifies, and button.component.ts cited this same node as authority for 40px. Now matches button.mybky.height.xl, which was already 42px.

default.comment: flat fill — no gradient, unlike mybky. Sampark Portal Figma node 13197:91897

hover.comment: light maroon tint on hover — spm-ui p-button-text

Figma node 13197:92094 (Secondary Ghost / Hover) references Mono/20% Black #1514140A — exactly color.sampark.mono.alpha4. Mirrors button.mybky.secondaryGhost.hover, which is the same 4% ink tint on the mybky mono ramp.

text.comment: Figma node 13197:92066 (Secondary Ghost / Default) — Mono/100 #151414. Sampark had no secondaryGhost block at all, so 8 of the 44 Button cells fell through to PrimeNG's stock text-secondary colours.
p-button-link — underline on hover, spm-ui only variant

background.comment: distinct disabled fill — not an opacity dim, see button.mapping.mdx

border.comment: hairline — structural separation, per CLAUDE.md 'Borders & shadows'

radius.comment: 8px. NOT radius.mybky.pill — the pill shape is for controls (buttons/inputs/badges), never containers

padding.comment: 24px — CLAUDE.md 'Spacing & Layout': space-5..space-6 inside a card

gap.comment: 16px — between header, body and footer (CLAUDE.md: space-4 within a block)

shadow.comment: raised variant ONLY. A card at rest has no shadow — see CLAUDE.md

radius.comment: 8px — radius.sampark.md's own comment already names cards/dialogs/toast
16px on the two INNER corners only — no radius.sampark.* step is this large; the scale tops out at md (8px) for cards/dialogs

width.comment: fluid — min 500px, scales with viewport above that; source config-sidebar spec

headerPaddingX.comment: 8px — the header row is inset inside the panel padding

maskBackground.comment: scrim behind the panel; Mono/100 at 45%

radius.comment: 32px. Far beyond radius.mybky.md (8px) — a drawer is its own surface tier, not a big card.

padding.comment: 32px, and it wraps header + body + footer together

headerGap.comment: 8px between title, actions and close — the same step the sampark half uses; the header row is identical geometry in both brands

headerBackground.comment: FLAT panel — header and footer have no bar of their own, they inherit the panel white. Recorded so nobody re-adds one.

radius.comment: Pill. The Sampark count badge is a circle/stadium, NOT the 4px chip — that shape belongs to tag.sampark, which this block previously duplicated (20/22/28 at 4px). p-tag is the colour/status label; p-badge is the count.

background.comment: alert count — the only filled-red element in the family

border.comment: white ring, so the badge still separates from whatever it overlaps

background.comment: a tint rather than an opaque fill, so it works on any surface

radius.comment: 99px pill — all sizes, Figma MyBKY Badge/Tag set (node 22465:95582)

l.comment: 32px, font 16px — Figma l and l-mob share the same box

xs.comment: 4px 4px — label adds 4px per side, so visual inset is 8px

s.comment: 4px 6px — default; label's 4px brings the visual inset to Figma's 10px

borderHover.comment: Figma Mono/60 hover ring — events-ui value predates the mybky mono scale (mono.500 is #6f777d); kept verbatim

background.comment: Figma 'Primary' variant — reached via severity="contrast" (the unqualified PrimeNG tag renders grey)
Error/20 — no matching step in color.mybky.error (80/100 only)

borderHover.comment: Success/100 — no matching step in color.mybky.success (50/400/600 only)

text.comment: Mono/40 'Disable Item' #8d9ba5. Was #bd9ba5, carried verbatim from events-ui and repeated in both badge style guides. The Figma disabled badge (22465:95659) binds this text to Mono/40 (Disable Item) = #8d9ba5, and Sampark's disabled badge (13197:90751) binds ITS text to its own Mono/40 — so both brands read the same token and #bd9ba5 was a one-character slip (b for 8) that the guides inherited

radius.comment: 4px — xs/s; l rounds to radiusL. Sampark's 'Badge' IS p-tag (spm-ui _badge.scss); NOT pill like mybky

fontWeight.comment: Inter 500 — all sizes, same as mybky

s.comment: 22px — default; spm-ui md is the same box, so baps-tag m also renders this

xs.comment: 0 4px — label carries no extra inset, unlike mybky's +4px label padding

background.comment: Figma 'Primary' maroon chip — reached via severity="contrast", same crossover as mybky. ALPHA, not the opaque primary.10 tint: the spm-ui badge spec writes this fill as rgba(135,48,48,.1), and a tag dropped on a tinted row has to keep what sits behind it. The two differ by roughly 5/255 on a white page, which is why the opaque one went unnoticed.
same fill as grey — color tokens mute it, opacity stays 1

radius.comment: full circle — differs from sampark's square avatars

background.comment: initials chip fill — not PrimeNG's grey default

radius.comment: xs–l squares — differs from mybky's full circle; xl/2xl round more, see radiusXl/radius2xl. Source: spm-ui _avatar.scss (Figma node 13197:90187)

background.comment: #fbf4f4 — the live variables.css value; the older theme-light $avatar-bg (#fbf3f3) predates the Figma-matched set

borderHover.comment: border darkens on hover; bg and text never change

text.comment: #595656 — one text color across all three types; the topbar's mono-100 initials are a spm-ui one-off override

background.comment: #f8f7f7 grey chip — replaces the older user-panel #f6f7f8 reading

#e8fcf0 — Figma node 13197:90388 (Icon Success / Default) labels this 'Success/20', but its VALUE is our success.10. Matched by value, not by name: Figma's success ramp labels sit one step above ours (its 'Success/80' #17b56c is our success.60).

borderHover.comment: #17b56c — node 13197:90412 (Icon Success / Hover) drops the mid step and uses Figma 'Success/80'.

background.comment: #fde8e8 — Figma node 13197:90436 (Icon Error / Default). NOTE the error ramp does NOT share the success skew: Figma's error labels line up with ours exactly.

color.comment: green presence dot, top-right, 1.5–2px white ring — not on the sampark palette; kept verbatim

background.comment: blue icon badge, bottom-right, white ring — not on the sampark palette; kept verbatim

trackOff.comment: cool grey — not on the mybky mono scale; kept verbatim from events-ui (Figma MyBKY 1.5 switch, node 22465:108921)

trackOn.comment: full-strength brand blue track; thumb stays WHITE when on (events-ui _switch.scss) — the earlier blue.200 track + blue.600 knob reading was wrong

thumbBg.comment: white in every state — on/off is carried by the track alone

thumbSize.comment: 17px — thumb sits fully inside the track (vs Material's overhanging 24px)

gap.comment: 1.5px thumb inset — PrimeNG's checked-position term reproduces events-ui's translate table exactly: md 36-17-1.5 = 17.5px, sm 13.5px, lg 17.5px
thumb inset from track edge, all sizes — also PrimeNG's checked-position term (width - thumb - gap)

radius.comment: 4px — md/lg track; SQUARE, not Material's pill. xs/sm round to radiusSm

searchWidth.comment: 256px — compact, matches the reference toolbar (title left / search+action right, single line, no wrap)

pageBackground.comment: #F8FAFB. The dashboard repaints itself grey ON TOP of the white layout shell, so cards read as floating. Settings/config do NOT — they inherit the shell white.

heroInvitedGradient.comment: Was hardcoded in event-dashboard.ts with no token behind it — the one screen that broke the token pattern.

chartCardShadow.comment: NO shadow, and no hover either. Only the region mini-cards lift.

regionGridGap.comment: 14px — OFF the 4px grid. Kept because it is what ships; flagged rather than silently rounded to 12 or 16.

rowBackground.comment: Every row. NO zebra striping anywhere in events-ui — confirmed, not an oversight.

rowHoverBackground.comment: Barely-there wash, lighter than mono.50. No token existed for it.

rowErrorBackground.comment: Live in payment-config error rows. events-ui also declares --comm-unavailable-row-bg with this value and never uses it — that one is dead, this is not.

embeddedRowHover.comment: Tables sitting INSIDE a dashboard card hover darker than standalone ones.

rowWarningBackground.comment: Warning/10. Refund rows in the Payment transactions table (Figma 25317:120737). Hover still overrides it — the Refund Hover variant paints Primary/0, not this.

rowHoverBackground.comment: #EEF0F8. Note this differs from the flat tables above, which hover #FBFCFD.

connectorColor.comment: #8D9BA5. The ONE place a darker line than border.default is used — the hierarchy trunk needs to read against the row borders it crosses.

expandedFontWeight.comment: An expanded parent gets weight only — no background change.

railBackground.comment: Primary/0. The pill behind the whole rail.

railPaddingY.comment: Per spec. Pill height then follows the 40px slot rather than being pinned.

slotSize.comment: 40px. Per the source spec (_event-shared.scss). The Figma frame 25317:104987 renders these circles at 32px; the spec is treated as authoritative because it is the shipping stylesheet.

slotSizeActive.comment: 56px. Size, not just colour, is what marks the current step on a rail whose labels are hidden.

activeGradient.comment: Primary/60 to Primary/80. Also the hover preview on an unlocked inactive slot, and the in-progress fill.

completedGradient.comment: Success/80 to Success/100. A finished step is the one place a green fill appears in the wizard.

connectorColor.comment: Mono/40. Solid, NOT dashed — measured from the shipping stylesheet.

activeLift.comment: 41.6px. translateY on the icon WRAP, not the button — the button already spends its transform on scale() during hover, so the lift needs its own element. Same amount for the real active step and for a hovered one.

hoverScale.comment: 40px x 1.4 = 56px VISUAL. Deliberately a scale, not a width change: the active step is genuinely 56px, a hovered one only looks it, so neighbours never reflow.
